body_ar:
الله تعالى محيط بخلقه علماً وقهراً، وحيثما توجهوا إليه أقبل عليهم، فلذلك ينبغي أن يراقب المرء ربه، ويمتثل شرعه وأمره.
ذكر صفات الإحاطة والصورة والوجه.
إثبات إحاطة الله بخلقه:
يقول الشيخ: [أحاط بالناس وأينما يول مستقبل فثم وجه الله جل] هذه صفة أخرى وهي صفة الإحاطة، وهذه الصفة عبارة عن صفتين: الصفة الأولى: صفة الإحاطة بمعنى كمال العلم والإدراك، وهذه هي معنى المعية العامة. والصفة الثانية: بمعنى القهر والجبروت، وهذه الإحاطة التي بمعنى القهر تنقسم إلى قسمين: ناجز ومتأخر. فالناجز منها: هو أخذ الله الوبيل الذي يأخذ به المكذبين، فأخذه الوبيل الذي يأخذهم به هو من إحاطته بمعنى قهره وجبروته، فهو قهر ناجز. وأما المتأخر فهو أخذهم يوم القيامة...
body_en:
*[Site synopsis]* God, exalted is He, encompasses His creation in knowledge and in overpowering might, and wherever they turn towards Him He turns towards them. A person should therefore be mindful of his Lord and should comply with His law and His command.

## The mention of the attributes of encompassing, form and face

## Affirming God's encompassing of His creation

The Sheikh says:

*[He has encompassed mankind; and wherever one turns to face, there is the face of God, majestic is He.]*

This is another attribute, the attribute of encompassing (iḥāṭah), and this attribute amounts to two attributes. The first is the attribute of encompassing in the sense of the perfection of knowledge and apprehension, and this is the meaning of the general accompaniment (al-maʿiyyah al-ʿāmmah). The second is in the sense of overpowering might and compelling dominion.

This encompassing, in the sense of overpowering, divides into two kinds: immediate and deferred. The immediate is God's grievous seizure, with which He seizes those who deny the truth; His grievous seizure with which He seizes them belongs to His encompassing in the sense of His overpowering and His compelling dominion, and so it is an immediate overpowering. As for the deferred, it is His seizing them on the Day of Resurrection…

flags.note: CRITICAL FOR DISPLAY. This line announces three attributes — encompassing, form (ṣūrah) and face (wajh). Only the first is reached before the record stops. The attribute of form is the most contested item in this whole series, and here it is named and then abandoned. The site must not present this page as the Sheikh's treatment of the divine form; the lesson's treatment of it sits in the .doc.

flags.context: صفة الإحاطة بمعنى كمال العلم والإدراك، وهذه هي معنى المعية العامة
flags.note: A fixed term of the discipline, paired with 'the specific accompaniment' (al-maʿiyyah al-khāṣṣah), which the record never reaches. 'Presence' would suggest spatial presence and so pre-judge the very question the term is designed to leave open. The literal rendering is kept and the Arabic retained.

flags.note: An allusion to 'أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا' at Sūrat al-Muzzammil 73:16; the Sheikh does not cite the verse, so the English does not supply the citation and keeps the adjective rather than naturalising it.

translator_notes: One of a run of fourteen records, IDs 734-747, the series 'The Names and Attributes', all built to the same template and all excerpts. Each carries a site-written synopsis, then a section heading, then the opening formula and the first lines of a lesson, and then breaks off on an ellipsis; the full text sits behind a .doc download in the /medias/doc/esmawesivat-* series, numbered 1 to 14 in the same order as the IDs.

The source's final line, 'تحميل المادة' ('download the material'), is the label of a download link in the page furniture, not part of the text. It is recorded as source_download_link and omitted from body_ar and body_en.

This record does carry a CMS timestamp in a .create_date span (10 May 2011, within a 28-minute window shared by the whole run 738-747). That is a bulk-upload timestamp for the series, not the date the lesson was given. Record 737, translated in an earlier wave, reports no date for this run; the timestamp is in fact present in the page and should be backfilled there.

Creedal material. Per style guide section 8, the vocabulary of divine attributes is not the vocabulary of the five legal rulings, and the five-rulings mapping is not applied to any predicate of God in this record.
The quoted line alludes to Sūrat al-Baqarah 2:115 without quoting it. The allusion is rendered as the verse renders it and is not marked as a quotation, because the Sheikh does not present it as one.

'القهر والجبروت' is rendered 'overpowering might and compelling dominion'. Both words are divine attributes here and neither is pejorative in Arabic; English 'tyranny' or 'coercion' for jabarūt would be a serious mistranslation in this context.

Marked critical_for_display: the record ends on the deferred seizing of those who deny the truth, with no treatment of the mercy side of the same attribute that the synopsis itself announces ('wherever they turn towards Him He turns towards them').
